tasks.short: Keep abreast of methodological and conceptual developments

steps.what: Find and verify relevant current literature and meeting material using the institution's actual library alerts and reference manager
inputs: Actual methodological interests
Actual library catalogue records and supplied meeting material
outputs: Verified relevant papers and meeting sources

steps.what: Read and critically assess the actual methodological literature and its relevance to biostatistics and life-science research
inputs: Verified full papers and methodological context
outputs: Understanding of methods, assumptions and limitations

steps.what: Attend actual meetings or conferences and talk with colleagues about methodological and conceptual developments
inputs: Actual conference contributions and colleague discussion
outputs: Professional learning and clarified methodological questions

tasks.design: Configure actual library alerts and reference-manager filters in the research-library {OPS_SYSTEM}. The biostatistician verifies sources, reads the papers and attends and discusses real methodological work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue searches can take time before substantive reading begins.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing library alerts and reference metadata can narrow retrieval without substituting a generated summary for the paper.
tasks.still_hard: Evaluating assumptions and deciding whether a method fits the actual research setting.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician critically assesses methods and learns through discussion.

ambition.what: Reduce literature discovery effort while retaining actual professional learning.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0-1; library owner confirms subscribed source access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: research libraries and reference managers can filter catalogue records and provide topic alerts.

assumptions: Publishers and the library produce actual records and papers; s1 verifies relevance and source resolution. No invented reference or unread summary counts as reading.
No conference registration send, attendance certificate or learning report is assumed for this professional-learning episode.
Illustrative gross saving 6 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1, net 5; existing equivalent alerts earn no new gain, and actual reading and meetings remain counted.
unknowns: Actual search effort and existing library-alert coverage
research_questions: Which recurring methodological searches can use the institution's existing alerts?

already_counted.description: Verify the retrieved literature and sources

incremental.description: Maintain topic filters and assess alert relevance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured literature-discovery scenario; reading and real attendance retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design research studies with clinical and scientific colleagues

steps.what: Collaborate with physicians and life scientists to define the actual study question, outcomes, feasibility constraints and available evidence
inputs: Actual clinical and scientific question
Actual colleague accounts and feasibility information
outputs: Agreed study-design brief and unresolved scientific questions

steps.what: Develop the actual design, estimand, sampling approach, assumptions and explicit sample-size or operating-characteristic scenarios
inputs: Actual agreed study brief and evidence
outputs: Biostatistician-authored design and checked numerical scenario specification

steps.what: Prepare and compute the specified scenario comparisons using checked statistical-package templates
inputs: Explicit checked scenario inputs and methods from s2
Existing tested statistical functions and comparison templates
outputs: Scenario-indexed numerical results and failure listing

steps.what: Check the actual numerical scenarios and assumptions with the study question and agree the defensible design contribution
inputs: Actual numerical results and failures
Study brief and source assumptions
outputs: Checked design conclusions and limitations

steps.what: Write and check the actual statistical design section in the working study protocol using existing approved headings and definitions
inputs: Checked design conclusions and actual scenario results
Existing working protocol and approved reusable definitions
outputs: Final checked working-protocol contribution

steps.what: Save the final checked design contribution in the same working protocol
inputs: Final checked working-protocol contribution
outputs: Saved working study-design contribution

tasks.design: Use checked scenario templates in {DATA_PLATFORM} and existing working-protocol blocks in {DOCS}. The biostatistician and clinical colleagues formulate the study, the statistician checks the results and writes the actual protocol contribution, and the final working version is saved separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated scenario preparation and collecting comparable results can add work after the scientific assumptions are defined.
tasks.enabler_now: Tested statistical templates can reuse exact scenario handling and approved protocol definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical relevance, defensible assumptions, feasibility and design trade-offs.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician translates the actual scientific question into a valid study design.

ambition.what: Compare additional explicitly justified design sensitivities before colleagues choose a study design.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; study owner authorizes actual protocol and evidence access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: tested statistical templates can prepare specified scenario comparisons and document templates can reuse approved definitions.

assumptions: Physicians and scientists supply actual clinical context in s1 and the biostatistician specifies and checks all numerical assumptions in s2. Missing effect, variability or feasibility inputs stop the affected scenario.
s3 replaces manual scenario setup and output collection, not statistical-engine runtime or an existing equivalent template.
This is actual collaborative design with an existing working protocol contribution. Saving that contribution does not approve a study, authorize recruitment or submit to a review body.
Illustrative gross saving 20.9 per 100 task hours, upkeep 3, net 17.9; live collaboration and actual design judgment remain fully counted, and the same-document save earns no gain.
unknowns: Existing scenario tooling and actual manual comparison preparation effort
research_questions: Which checked design scenarios are manually reconstructed for each protocol revision?

already_counted.description: Specify the design and numerical assumptions, check results and write and check the actual protocol contribution

incremental.description: Maintain and benchmark scenario templates and approved protocol blocks

approvals.approved_version: Final working-protocol contribution checked in s5; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured collaborative-design episode with manual scenario setup today; all scientific decisions and checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define and check actual table shells, graph specifications, populations, denominators, labels and disclosure requirements
inputs: Actual analysis plan and reporting purpose
Actual clinical-study definitions
outputs: Biostatistician-authored table and graph specification

steps.what: Receive and check the actual approved clinical analysis dataset, dictionary, version and access partition
inputs: Actual dataset and dictionary supplied by the study data owner
Actual permitted access and study version
outputs: Checked input contract and dataset reference

steps.what: Map and derive the specified display populations, categories and summary inputs from the checked dataset
inputs: Checked dataset and dictionary from s2
Approved table and graph specification from s1
outputs: Derived display inputs with explicit derivation and mapping exceptions

steps.what: Assemble the specified clinical tables and graphs with exact labels, denominators, source versions and footnotes
inputs: Derived display inputs from s3
Checked shells, graph specifications and reusable output templates
outputs: Draft clinical tables and graphs with source references

steps.what: Check all displayed results, denominators, labels, footnotes, disclosure restrictions and derivations against sources and independent benchmark checks
inputs: Complete draft tables and graphs
Actual dataset, specification and independent check outputs
outputs: Final checked clinical tables and graphs or withheld discrepancies

steps.what: Save the final checked tables and graphs in the existing authorized study workspace
inputs: Final checked clinical tables and graphs
outputs: Saved clinical display pack

tasks.design: Build exact display derivation and output templates in {DATA_PLATFORM}, assembling the specified clinical tables and graphs into {DOCS}. The biostatistician supplies the specifications and checks all final results and disclosure scope before saving the pack.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated display-variable mapping and manual output assembly can duplicate effort across study versions.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned deterministic display pipelines can reuse checked derivations and output shells.
tasks.still_hard: Correct populations, clinical interpretation, denominator choices and disclosure restrictions.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician judges whether the display represents the actual clinical question accurately.

ambition.what: Regenerate the same specified display pack from a newly checked study-data version.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; study data owner approves dataset access, partitions and output audience

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic statistical pipelines can derive display inputs and assemble clinical tables and figures from explicit specifications.

assumptions: The study data owner supplies the actual approved analysis dataset and dictionary; its capture, cleaning and analysis derivations are counted in their producing workflows. s2 checks the received version and permitted access.
The biostatistician authors actual shells and derivation rules in s1; missing variables, ambiguous mappings or failed independent checks stop affected output.
s3 and s4 replace currently manual repeated mapping and output assembly, not existing numerical calculation or graph-rendering runtime. Equivalent existing reporting pipelines earn no new gain.
Independent check implementation and validation are included in rollout and ongoing upkeep; the actual final comparison remains in s5. No language model computes clinical numbers.
Illustrative gross saving 50 per 100 task hours, upkeep 5, net 45; same-workspace saving earns no gain and no external report is sent.
unknowns: Existing table-generation pipeline coverage and actual manual layout effort
research_questions: Which display inputs and table shells are manually rebuilt when the study dataset changes?

already_counted.description: Specify clinical displays, check actual dataset inputs and verify all final output

incremental.description: Maintain derivation and display templates and independent benchmark checks

approvals.approved_version: Complete clinical display pack and access scope checked in s5; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured repeated-display scenario with manual derivation mapping and assembly today; actual specifications and full verification retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Specify actual analysis methods, dataset contract, expected outputs and test cases from the approved analysis plan
inputs: Actual approved analysis plan and dataset dictionary
Actual study-data access boundaries
outputs: Biostatistician-authored code specification and expected test cases

steps.what: Assemble exact existing checked analysis modules and standard input-output scaffolding for the supplied specification
inputs: Actual code specification from s1
Existing checked module library and explicit module mappings
outputs: Draft program skeleton and unsupported-requirement list

steps.what: Draft and edit the remaining analysis code from the actual specification, using a bounded coding assistant where institutional policy allows
inputs: Actual specification and program skeleton
Permitted dictionary and synthetic or approved test inputs
outputs: Untrusted draft analysis code

loop.purpose: Draft missing analysis code to an explicit statistical specification
loop.input: Actual code specification, permitted dictionary, skeleton and test contracts
loop.output: Draft code without authority to change data or release results
loop.check: Biostatistician reviews every method and derivation in s4 and executes independent benchmark and edge-case checks in s5
loop.stop: Unsupported method, data-access violation, failed benchmark or unexplained output returns to manual coding; no commit
loop.why_not_simpler: The remaining study-specific code needs semantic translation of requirements; exact reusable modules are assembled first in s2

steps.what: Review and correct all program code against the actual statistical methods, derivations, access restrictions and output contract
inputs: Complete draft code
Actual analysis specification and module contracts
outputs: Reviewed program ready for controlled testing

steps.what: Run controlled tests and independent numerical benchmarks, inspect failures and check the complete final code and test record
inputs: Reviewed program
Actual expected test cases and independent benchmark outputs
Permitted test dataset
outputs: Final checked analysis code and test record or withheld failures

steps.what: Save the final checked code and test record in the existing controlled analysis workspace
inputs: Final checked analysis code and test record
outputs: Saved checked program version

tasks.design: Assemble existing checked modules in {DATA_PLATFORM} and use a bounded coding assistant only for remaining code against the actual analysis specification. The biostatistician reviews the complete program and validates it against independent tests before the separate final save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated scaffolding and first-draft study-specific code can take time after methods are specified.
tasks.enabler_now: Module libraries and bounded coding assistance can reduce drafting without giving a model control of data or results.
tasks.still_hard: Correct statistical implementation, subtle edge cases and independent numerical validation.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician understands why the analysis is valid and can detect a plausible but wrong implementation.

ambition.what: Reduce code drafting while retaining specification, full review and controlled testing.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; study and platform owners approve assistant access, permitted inputs and code controls

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checked module reuse and coding assistants can draft statistical programs, but independent method and numerical checks remain necessary.

assumptions: The biostatistician supplies actual methods and test expectations in s1 and selects explicit existing module mappings. Missing or unsupported requirements remain manual, not inferred.
The assistant receives only institutionally permitted specifications and dictionary or synthetic inputs; no confidential patient records are uploaded by default.

The study data owner supplies permitted test data through the actual data workflow; s5 counts test execution and comparison. The assistant cannot change source data, launch an uncontrolled analysis or release results.

s2 replaces repeated manual code assembly, not existing scaffolding already automated. A newly needed library or independent benchmark implementation is not free and is included in build and maintenance effort.
Illustrative gross saving 30 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 26; final same-workspace saving has no gain.
unknowns: Existing checked module coverage and coding-assistant permission
research_questions: Which analysis code is repeatedly written despite available checked modules, and what independent benchmarks exist?

already_counted.description: Specify methods and tests, review code drafts and complete method and independent numerical checks

incremental.description: Maintain module contracts and benchmark suites and review assistant draft quality

approvals.approved_version: Final program and test record checked in s5; changes require rechecking and retesting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured code-authoring scenario with manual module assembly and first drafts today; specification, complete review and independent tests retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Agree actual dataset and output contracts with study data owners and clinical colleagues.
skills_to_grow: Maintain tested scenario and display templates
Specify and independently verify statistical code
Trace every clinical display to source data
role.ambitious_version: A biostatistician who reuses checked code and output specifications while retaining study design, clinical interpretation and independent numerical validation.
